title: Senior Lead Engineer - IT
jobDescription:
Job Summary: The Team Coach
- Coaching & Transformation for India supports the scaling and sustained adoption of BTOM-aligned ways of working and promotes consistent, high-quality coaching practices across assigned product teams and value streams Job Description: Coach product teams on agile practices to drive delivery discipline and predictability. Provide 1:1 role-based coaching for Product Owners and other team members to strengthen agile maturity. Apply coaching methodologies to support cross-functional product teams in improving collaboration, enhancing delivery cadence, and achieving outcomes aligned with product goals. Facilitate team-level ceremonies (e.g., planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) to ensure effective collaboration, alignment, and dependency management. Coordinate with other teams to manage cross-team dependencies and maintain alignment. Escalate blockers to senior coaches or leadership as needed to ensure timely resolution. Support teams in improving performance through ongoing inspection of team practices and adoption of new approaches. Work with teams to define and develop objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities; assist in tracking progress through performance dashboards. Guide teams to leverage flow and outcome metrics effectively to inform improvement; support development of targeted coaching plans to enhance team performance and maturity. Contribute as a member of the Center of Excellence by adopting standards, sharing learnings, and supporting continuous evolution of the operating model. Partner with Product Owners to build and maintain a strong backlog aligned with product strategy and priorities. Collaborate with stakeholders to support team needs and maintain alignment with product goals. Reinforce team understanding of how their work contributes to product and value stream OKRs. Must have: 9–10 years of experience in roles such as Scrum Master or Agile Coach, working with agile teams in a scaled environment. Good knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) with experience in agile delivery practices and ability to reinforce strong team habits. Ability to coach teams using supportive and adaptive techniques to drive continuous improvement. Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, SPM) and applying best practices for team-level adoption. Exposure to OKR development and outcome-based performance tracking. Solid understanding of software development lifecycle and technology delivery. Familiarity with product platform constructs preferred. Working knowledge of engineering practices such as test automation, CI/CD, and Dev Ops. Good facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to maintain alignment and transparency across teams and stakeholders. Good to have skills: Developing enterprise mindset beyond team-level execution Ownership and accountability for team-level outcomes Inclination towards action, experimentation, and continuous improvement Location: This position can be based in any of the following locations: Chennai Current Guardian Colleagues: Please apply through the internal Jobs Hub in Workday Every day, Guardian helps our 29 million customers realize their dreams through a range of insurance and financial products and services. title: Lead Engineer - IT
jobDescription: Job Description: Java Full Stack Developer (5–8 Years Experience) We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in Spring Boot, Microservices, and solid Core Java fundamentals. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in developing scalable, high‑performance applications, along with proficiency in relational databases, CI/CD pipelines, and testing frameworks. Familiarity with AWS and modern Dev Ops practices will be an added advantage. Experience with event-driven architecture while working with platforms such as Kafka, SNS/SQS is also valuable. In addition, front-end development experience is required, with a preference for React JS or Angular JS. The candidate will be expected to contribute to front-end development as a core part of their role. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Java-based applications using Spring Boot and Microservices architecture. Build and implement RESTful APIs, ensuring efficient communication and integration across services. Develop, optimize, and maintain database schemas and queries for My SQL and Postgre SQL. Apply object-oriented principles and design patterns to deliver clean, modular, and maintainable code. Develop and maintain front-end applications using React JS or Angular JS, working closely with UI/UX designers to deliver seamless user experiences. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Git, and Maven/Gradle. Write, execute, and maintain unit and integration tests using frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito. Collaborate with QA, Dev Ops, Product Management, and other cross-functional teams. Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting issues, and perform application performance tuning. Stay up to date with emerging technologies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to debug, analytical skills, prod support. Required Skills & Qualifications 5–8 years of professional development experience in Java & front-end technologies. Strong proficiency in Core Java (Collections, Multithreading, Exception Handling, Streams, etc.). Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Microservices architecture. Solid understanding of RESTful services and API design principles. Experience working with My SQL and Postgre SQL databases. Experience with front-end development using React JS or Angular JS. The candidate must be able to contribute to front-end coding, troubleshooting, and collaboration with UI/UX teams. Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git, Maven/Gradle). Proficiency in unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito). Good understanding of software design principles and common design patterns. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Familiarity with AWS services (ECS, EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) is a plus. Leveraging AI productivity tools such as Github Co-pilot. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
